title: Endpoint Ricci-energy balance and Weyl-dominated blow-ups under bounded scalar curvature
exact_target: Let $(M^n,g_t)_{t\in[0,T)}$ be a Ricci flow with $T<\infty$. Assume $R <1$ on $M\times [0,T)$. Characterize $g_t$ as $t\to T$.
